metadata.title: Making Gradient Descent Optimal for Strongly Convex Stochastic Optimization

nodes.name: Convex Stochastic Optimization (Strongly Convex)
nodes.statement: Minimize a $\lambda$-strongly convex function $F$ over a convex domain $\Wcal$ using only a stochastic gradient oracle that returns $\hat{\bg}$ with $\E[\hat{\bg}]\in\partial F(\bw)$, using $T$ oracle calls; bound $F(\bw_T)-F(\bw^*)$.
nodes.statement_clean: Minimize an unknown strongly convex function from T noisy subgradient queries; bound the suboptimality.

nodes.name: $\lambda$-Strongly Convex Function
nodes.statement: $F$ is $\lambda$-strongly convex if for all $\bw,\bw'\in\Wcal$ and any subgradient $\bg$ of $F$ at $\bw$: $F(\bw')\geq F(\bw)+\inner{\bg,\bw'-\bw}+\frac{\lambda}{2}\norm{\bw'-\bw}^2$.
nodes.statement_clean: F is lower-bounded by a quadratic in any direction.

nodes.name: $\mu$-Smoothness w.r.t. $\bw^*$
nodes.statement: $F$ is $\mu$-smooth with respect to $\bw^*$ if for all $\bw\in\Wcal$: $F(\bw)-F(\bw^*)\leq \frac{\mu}{2}\norm{\bw-\bw^*}^2$.
nodes.statement_clean: F is upper-bounded by a quadratic centered at the optimum.

nodes.name: Average Iterate $\bar{\bw}_T$
nodes.statement: $\bar{\bw}_T = \frac{1}{T}(\bw_1+\ldots+\bw_T)$, the average of the SGD iterates.
nodes.statement_clean: Standard Polyak-Ruppert averaging.

nodes.name: $\alpha$-Suffix Average $\bar{\bw}^{\alpha}_T$
nodes.statement: $\bar{\bw}^{\alpha}_T = \frac{\bw_{(1-\alpha)T+1}+\ldots+\bw_T}{\alpha T}$ for $\alpha\in(0,1)$: average only the last $\alpha T$ iterates.
nodes.statement_clean: Average only the final fraction alpha of the SGD trajectory.

nodes.name: Bounded Second Moment of Stochastic Gradient
nodes.statement: $\E[\norm{\hat{\bg}_t}^2]\leq G^2$ for all $t$, regardless of how the iterates evolve.
nodes.statement_clean: Stochastic gradient has uniformly bounded second moment.

nodes.name: Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD) with $\eta_t=1/\lambda t$
nodes.statement: Initialize $\bw_1=\mathbf{0}$. For $t=1,\ldots,T$: query the stochastic gradient oracle for $\hat{\bg}_t$ at $\bw_t$; set $\bw_{t+1}=\Pi_{\Wcal}(\bw_t-\eta_t \hat{\bg}_t)$.
nodes.statement_clean: Projected stochastic gradient descent with $1/\lambda t$ step size.
output: A returned point: last iterate $\bw_{T+1}$, average $\bar{\bw}_T$, or suffix average $\bar{\bw}^{\alpha}_T$

nodes.name: Epoch-GD
nodes.statement: Optimal algorithm of Hazan and Kale for strongly convex stochastic optimization: divides $T$ iterations into exponentially increasing epochs, runs SGD with averaging on each, uses each epoch's output as the next epoch's start; returns the final epoch's point.
nodes.statement_clean: Exponentially increasing epochs of averaged SGD; cited optimal $O(1/T)$ baseline.

nodes.name: SVM Objective
nodes.statement: $F(\bw) = \frac{\lambda}{2}\norm{\bw}^2 + \frac{1}{m}\sum_{i=1}^{m}\max\{0,1-y_i\inner{\bx_i,\bw}\}$.
nodes.statement_clean: Regularized hinge-loss objective for linear SVM.

nodes.name: Last-Iterate $O(1/T)$ Rate for Smooth Strongly Convex SGD
nodes.statement: If $F$ is $\lambda$-strongly convex and $\mu$-smooth w.r.t. $\bw^*$ over $\Wcal$, $\E[\norm{\hat{\bg}_t}^2]\leq G^2$, and $\eta_t=1/\lambda t$, then $\E[F(\bw_T)-F(\bw^*)]\leq \frac{2\mu G^2}{\lambda^2 T}$.
nodes.statement_clean: For smooth strongly convex F, the last SGD iterate achieves the optimal $O(1/T)$ rate.

nodes.name: Distance Decay Lemma
nodes.statement: If $F$ is $\lambda$-strongly convex over $\Wcal$, $\E[\norm{\hat{\bg}_t}^2]\leq G^2$, and $\eta_t=1/\lambda t$, then $\E[\norm{\bw_T-\bw^*}^2]\leq \frac{4G^2}{\lambda^2 T}$.
nodes.statement_clean: Expected squared distance of SGD iterate to optimum decays as $1/T$ for any strongly convex F.

nodes.name: $O(1/T)$ Rate for Average Iterate (Smooth Case)
nodes.statement: If $F$ is $\lambda$-strongly convex and $\mu$-smooth w.r.t. $\bw^*$, $\E[\norm{\hat{\bg}_t}^2]\leq G^2$, and $\eta_t=1/\lambda t$, then $\E[F(\bar{\bw}_T)-F(\bw^*)]\leq \frac{16\mu G^2}{\lambda^2 T}$.
nodes.statement_clean: Average SGD iterate also attains the optimal $O(1/T)$ rate when F is smooth.

nodes.name: $\Omega(\log T/T)$ Lower Bound for SGD-Average (Border Optimum)
nodes.statement: For $F(\bw)=\frac{1}{2}\norm{\bw}^2+w_1$ on $\Wcal=[0,1]^d$ with the prescribed stochastic gradient, if $\eta_t=c/t$, then for any $T\geq T_0+1$ with $T_0=\max\{2,c/2\}$: $\E[F(\bar{\bw}_T)-F(\bw^*)]\geq \frac{c}{16T}\sum_{t=T_0}^{T-1}\frac{1}{t}=\Omega(\log T/T)$.
nodes.statement_clean: When the optimum lies on a corner of W, SGD with averaging is provably $\Omega(\log T/T)$.

nodes.name: $\Omega(\log T/T)$ Lower Bound for SGD-Average (Interior Optimum)
nodes.statement: For the $1$-strongly convex $F(\bw)=\frac{1}{2}\norm{\bw}^2+\begin{cases}w_1 & w_1\geq 0\\ -7w_1 & w_1<0\end{cases}$ on $\Wcal=[-1,1]^d$ with the prescribed gradient oracle, if $w_{1,1}\geq 0$, $\eta_t=c/t$, $T_0=\max\{2,6c+1\}$, $T\geq T_0+2$: $\E[F(\bar{\bw}_T)-F(\bw^*)]\geq \frac{3c}{16T}\sum_{t=T_0+2}^{T}\frac{1}{t}-\frac{T_0}{T}=\Omega(\log T/T)$.
nodes.statement_clean: Even with optimum in the interior, non-smoothness forces SGD-average to a $\Omega(\log T/T)$ rate.

nodes.name: $O(1/T)$ Upper Bound for $\alpha$-Suffix Averaging
nodes.statement: For SGD with $\alpha$-suffix averaging, $\eta_t=1/\lambda t$, $F$ $\lambda$-strongly convex, $\E[\norm{\hat{\bg}_t}^2]\leq G$: $\E[F(\bar{\bw}^{\alpha}_T)-F(\bw^*)]\leq \frac{2+2.5\log(1/(1-\alpha))}{\alpha}\frac{G^2}{\lambda T}$.
nodes.statement_clean: Suffix averaging achieves the optimal $O(1/T)$ rate even without smoothness.

nodes.name: High-Probability Distance Bound
nodes.statement: Let $\delta\in(0,1/e)$, $T\geq 4$, $F$ $\lambda$-strongly convex, $\norm{\hat{\bg}_t}^2\leq G^2$ a.s., $\eta_t=1/\lambda t$. Then with probability $\geq 1-\delta$, for any $t\leq T$: $\norm{\bw_t-\bw^*}^2\leq \frac{(624\log(\log(T)/\delta)+1)G^2}{\lambda^2 t}$.
nodes.statement_clean: High-probability strengthening of Lemma close giving $1/t$ distance with $\log\log T$ overhead.

nodes.name: Initial-Distance Bound
nodes.statement: If $\E[\norm{\hat{\bg}_1}^2]\leq G^2$, then $\E[\norm{\bw_1-\bw^*}^2]\leq \frac{4G^2}{\lambda^2}$.
nodes.statement_clean: Strong convexity bounds the distance from the initial point to the optimum by the gradient bound.

nodes.name: Freedman's Inequality (Uniform Form)
nodes.statement: Let $d_1,\ldots,d_T$ be a martingale difference sequence with $|d_i|\leq b$, and let $V_s=\sum_{i=1}^{s}\var(d_i\mid d_1,\ldots,d_{i-1})$. Then for all $a,v>0$: $\Prob{\sum_{i=1}^s d_i\geq a \text{ and } V_s\leq v \text{ for some } s\leq T}\leq \exp\left(\frac{-a^2}{2(v+ba)}\right)$.
nodes.statement_clean: Freedman-type concentration for bounded martingales with conditional-variance control.

nodes.name: Maximal Freedman Bound (Bartlett-style)
nodes.statement: Let $d_1,\ldots,d_T$ be a martingale difference sequence with $|d_i|\leq b$, $V_s=\sum_{t=1}^{s}\var_{t-1}(d_t)$, $\sigma_s=\sqrt{V_s}$. For $\delta<1/e$, $T\geq 4$: $\Prob{\sum_{t=1}^s d_t > 2\max\{2\sigma_s,b\sqrt{\log(1/\delta)}\}\sqrt{\log(1/\delta)} \text{ for some } s\leq T}\leq \log(T)\delta$.
nodes.statement_clean: Adaptive Freedman bound with discretization, used to control martingale tails uniformly in s.

nodes.name: Lemma Above 0 (One-Sided Constraint)
nodes.statement: For any $t\geq T_0=\max\{2,6c+1\}$, $w_{t,1}\geq -c/(t-1)$, and if $w_{t,1}<0$ then $w_{t+1,1}\geq 5c/t$.
nodes.statement_clean: In the non-smooth example, the iterate cannot stay negative for two consecutive rounds.

nodes.name: Uniform Distance Upper Bound
nodes.statement: Under the conditions of Proposition closehighprob, for all $t$: $\norm{\bw_t-\bw^*}\leq \frac{2G}{\lambda}$ with probability 1.
nodes.statement_clean: Almost-sure version of the distance bound under bounded stochastic gradients.

nodes.name: Recursive-Form Distance Decomposition
nodes.statement: Under the conditions of Proposition closehighprob, for any $t\geq 2$: $\norm{\bw_{t+1}-\bw^*}^2\leq \frac{2}{\lambda(t-1)t}\sum_{i=2}^{t}(i-1)\inner{\hat{\bz}_i,\bw_i-\bw^*}+\frac{G^2}{\lambda^2 t}$, where $\hat{\bz}_i=\bg_i-\hat{\bg}_i$.
nodes.statement_clean: Unrolls the SGD recursion into a martingale sum plus a deterministic $1/t$ term.

nodes.name: Proof of Lemma close (LP8.1)
nodes.statement: Strong convexity yields $(1-2\eta_t\lambda)\E[\norm{\bw_t-\bw^*}^2]+\eta_t^2 G^2$ recurrence; with $\eta_t=1/\lambda t$ this becomes $(1-2/t)\E[\norm{\bw_t-\bw^*}^2]+G^2/(\lambda^2 t^2)$, and induction starting from Lemma distance gives $4G^2/(\lambda^2 t)$.

nodes.name: Proof of Theorem average (TP8.2)
nodes.statement: Recursion for $\bar{\bw}_{t+1}$ combined with Cauchy-Schwartz and Lemma close yields $\E[\norm{\bar{\bw}_T-\bw^*}^2]\leq 32G^2/(\lambda^2 T)$ by induction; smoothness then gives the suboptimality bound.

nodes.name: Proof of Theorem simple (TP8.3)
nodes.statement: Conditional on $Z_t\leq -1/2$, $w_{t+1,1}\geq \eta_t/2$; Pr$(Z_t\leq -1/2)=1/8$ gives $\E[w_{t+1,1}]\geq \eta_t/16$, summing yields the lower bound.

nodes.name: Proof of Theorem involved (TP8.4)
nodes.statement: Lemma above0 ensures $w_{t,1}<0$ implies $w_{t+1,1}\geq 5c/t$; bounding Pr$(w_{t,1}\notin[0,c/t]\mid w_{t-1,1}\geq 0)\geq 3/4$ yields $\E[\bar{w}_{T,1}]\geq (3c/16T)\sum 1/t-T_0/T$.

nodes.name: Proof of Theorem alphaaveraging (TP8.5)
nodes.statement: Sum the per-step recurrence over the suffix, lower-bound the inner-product sum via convexity, plug Lemma close to bound $\E[\norm{\bw_t-\bw^*}^2]$, and use $\sum_{(1-\alpha)T+1}^{T}1/t\leq \log(1/(1-\alpha))$.

nodes.name: Proof of Proposition closehighprob (PrP8.1)
nodes.statement: Bound conditional variance and uniform step size of $(i-1)Z_i$ via Lemma uniformupperbound, apply Lemma fromFreedman to the martingale $\sum (i-1)Z_i$, plug into the recursive decomposition (Lemma recursive-def), then use induction with $a=(624\log(\log T/\delta)+1)G^2/\lambda^2$.

nodes.name: Smooth Artificial Experiment ($F=\norm{\bw}^2$ on $[-1,1]^5$)
nodes.statement: On $\Wcal=[-1,1]^5$, $F(\bw)=\norm{\bw}^2$, $\hat{\bg}=\bw+\bz$ with $\bz$ uniform on $[-1,1]^5$: all four algorithms achieve $\Theta(1/T)$ rate; SGD-A has worse constants.
nodes.statement_clean: Smooth synthetic experiment: SGD variants and Epoch-GD all attain $1/T$.

nodes.name: Non-Smooth Artificial Experiment (Theorem-involved instance, $d=5$)
nodes.statement: Simulating the non-smooth instance from Theorem involved with $d=5$: SGD-A shows $\Theta(\log(T)/T)$; SGD-L, SGD-$\alpha$, Epoch-GD show $\Theta(1/T)$.
nodes.statement_clean: Non-smooth synthetic experiment confirms the theory: only SGD-A is suboptimal.

nodes.name: SVM Experiments on ccat / cov1 / astro-ph
nodes.statement: On three binary classification datasets with the SVM hinge-loss objective and stochastic gradients $\hat{\bg}_t=\lambda \bw_t-\mathbf{1}_{y_i\inner{\bx_i,\bw_t}\leq 1}y_i\bx_i$: SGD-A is worst; SGD-L, SGD-$\alpha$, Epoch-GD perform similarly.
nodes.statement_clean: Real-data SVM experiments: averaging-all is worst; suffix-average and last-iterate match Epoch-GD.

nodes.name: Justifying $\eta_t=\Theta(1/t)$
nodes.statement: If $\eta_t=o(1/t)$, on $F(w)=w^2/2$ deterministically, $w_T=\prod(1-\eta_t)$ cannot be $O(1/T)$ unless $\sum\eta_t=\Omega(\log T)$, forcing $\eta_t\geq \Omega(1/t)$. If $\eta_t=\omega(1/t)$, the variance argument from Theorem simple shows $\E[F(w_t)]\geq \eta_t/16$, forcing $\eta_t=O(1/t)$.
nodes.statement_clean: Both sides force the canonical $1/t$ step-size schedule.

nodes.name: Last Iterate Rate for Non-Smooth Strongly Convex SGD
nodes.statement: Does standard SGD without averaging attain an $\Ocal(1/T)$ rate for general (possibly non-smooth) strongly convex $F$? Current theory only gives $\Ocal(1/\sqrt{T})$ via Jensen's inequality, while experiments suggest $\Theta(1/T)$.
nodes.statement_clean: Open: does last-iterate SGD reach optimal $1/T$ in the non-smooth strongly convex case?

nodes.name: Initialize $\bw_1=\mathbf{0}$
nodes.statement: Set the starting iterate $\bw_1=\mathbf{0}\in\Wcal$.

nodes.name: For $t=1,\ldots,T$ loop body
nodes.statement: For each $t$: query the stochastic-gradient oracle at $\bw_t$ to obtain $\hat{\bg}_t$ with $\E[\hat{\bg}_t]=\bg_t\in\partial F(\bw_t)$; then update $\bw_{t+1}=\Pi_{\Wcal}(\bw_t-\eta_t \hat{\bg}_t)$.

nodes.name: Return chosen output point
nodes.statement: Return one of: the last iterate $\bw_{T+1}$, the full average $\bar{\bw}_T=\frac{1}{T}\sum_{t=1}^{T}\bw_t$, or the $\alpha$-suffix average $\bar{\bw}^{\alpha}_T$.

nodes.name: Strong-convexity inner-product inequality
nodes.statement: Strong convexity of $F$ and optimality of $\bw^*$ give $\inner{\bg_t,\bw_t-\bw^*}\geq F(\bw_t)-F(\bw^*)+\frac{\lambda}{2}\norm{\bw_t-\bw^*}^2$ and $F(\bw_t)-F(\bw^*)\geq \frac{\lambda}{2}\norm{\bw_t-\bw^*}^2$.

nodes.name: Expand projection update
nodes.statement:
Use $
orm{\Pi_{\Wcal}( v)- w}\leq 
orm{ v- w}$ to expand $\E
orm{ w_{t+1}- w^*}^2$ in terms of $\E
orm{ w_t- w^*}^2$, $\E\inner{ g_t, w_t- w^*}$, and $\eta_t^2 \E
orm{\hat{ g}_t}^2$.

nodes.name: Combine to obtain recurrence
nodes.statement: Substituting PSP8.1 into PSP8.2 yields the recurrence $\E[\norm{\bw_{t+1}-\bw^*}^2]\leq (1-2\eta_t\lambda)\E[\norm{\bw_t-\bw^*}^2]+\eta_t^2 G^2$.

nodes.name: Plug $\eta_t=1/\lambda t$
nodes.statement: Setting $\eta_t=1/\lambda t$ gives $\E[\norm{\bw_{t+1}-\bw^*}^2]\leq (1-2/t)\E[\norm{\bw_t-\bw^*}^2]+G^2/(\lambda^2 t^2)$.

nodes.name: Induction with base case from Lemma distance
nodes.statement: By Lemma distance (LP8.2), $\E\norm{\bw_1-\bw^*}^2\leq 4G^2/\lambda^2$; the recurrence then gives $\E\norm{\bw_t-\bw^*}^2\leq 4G^2/(\lambda^2 t)$ for $t=2$, and induction (base $t=3$) yields the claim for all $t$.

nodes.name: Recursive identity for $\bar{\bw}_{t+1}$
nodes.statement: Decompose $\bar{\bw}_{t+1}=\frac{t}{t+1}\bar{\bw}_t+\frac{1}{t+1}\bw_{t+1}$ and expand $\E\norm{\bar{\bw}_{t+1}-\bw^*}^2$ via the cross-term identity.

nodes.name: Apply Cauchy-Schwartz and Lemma close
nodes.statement: Bound the cross term by $\E[|XY|]\leq\sqrt{\E[X^2]}\sqrt{\E[Y^2]}$ and use Lemma close (LP8.1) to bound $\E\norm{\bw_{t+1}-\bw^*}^2\leq 4G^2/(\lambda^2(t+1))$.

nodes.name: Induction yields $\E\norm{\bar{\bw}_T-\bw^*}^2\leq 32G^2/(\lambda^2 T)$
nodes.statement: By induction (base from Lemma distance LP8.2) the resulting inequality $\big(\tfrac{t}{t+1}\big)^2 a_t+\tfrac{4G}{\lambda(t+1)^{3/2}}\sqrt{a_t}+\tfrac{4G^2}{\lambda^2(t+1)^3}$ gives $\E\norm{\bar{\bw}_T-\bw^*}^2\leq 32G^2/(\lambda^2 T)$.

nodes.name: Apply $\mu$-smoothness to conclude
nodes.statement: Smoothness of $F$ w.r.t. $\bw^*$ gives $F(\bar{\bw}_T)-F(\bw^*)\leq \frac{\mu}{2}\norm{\bar{\bw}_T-\bw^*}^2$; combine with PSP8.8 to obtain the $16\mu G^2/(\lambda^2 T)$ bound.

nodes.name: Write coordinate-1 SGD recursion
nodes.statement: From the projected SGD update, $w_{t+1,1}=\Pi_{[0,1]}((1-\eta_t)w_{t,1}-\eta_t Z_t)$.

nodes.name: Case split on $Z_t$
nodes.statement: Conditional on $Z_t\leq -1/2$ and using $\eta_t\leq 2$, $w_{t+1,1}\geq \eta_t/2$; conditional on $Z_t>-1/2$, the domain forces $w_{t+1,1}\geq 0$.

nodes.name: Take expectation: $\E[w_{t+1,1}]\geq \eta_t/16$
nodes.statement: Combining the two cases with $\Pr(Z_t\leq -1/2)=1/8$ on $Z_t\sim U[-1,3]$ gives $\E[w_{t+1,1}]\geq \frac{1}{16}\eta_t$.

nodes.name: Sum over $t$ and convert to $F$
nodes.statement: Summing $\E[w_{t,1}]\geq \eta_{t-1}/16$ over $t=T_0+1,\ldots,T$ gives $\E[\bar{w}_{T,1}]\geq \frac{1}{16T}\sum_{t=T_0}^{T-1}\eta_t$, and $F(\bar{\bw}_T)\geq \bar{w}_{T,1}$ on this instance with $\bw^*=\mathbf{0}$.

nodes.name: Invoke Lemma above 0
nodes.statement: By Lemma above0 (LP8.4), for $t\geq T_0$, $w_{t,1}<0$ implies $w_{t+1,1}\geq 5c/t$, and $w_{t,1}+w_{t+1,1}\geq 3c/t$.

nodes.name: Lower-bound $\E\sum w_{t,1}$ by indicator argument
nodes.statement: Pair iterates so that $\E[w_{T_0,1}+\ldots+w_{T,1}]\geq \sum_t \Pr(w_{t,1}\notin[0,\eta_t])\frac{c}{2t}$ via splitting the cases $w_{t,1}<0$ and $w_{t,1}>c/t$.

nodes.name: Bound $\Pr(w_{t,1}\in[0,c/t]\mid w_{t-1,1}\geq 0)\leq 1/4$
nodes.statement: For $Z_t\sim U[-1,3]$ (length-4 interval), the event traps $Z_t$ in a length-1 interval, so the conditional probability is $\leq 1/4$, giving $\Pr(w_{t,1}\notin[0,c/t]\mid w_{t-1,1}\geq 0)\geq 3/4$.

nodes.name: Combine using non-consecutive-zero indicator
nodes.statement: By LP8.4 the indicators $\mathbf{1}_{w_{t,1}\geq 0}$ cannot equal 0 in two consecutive rounds, so $\mathbf{1}_{w_{t-1,1}\geq 0}+\mathbf{1}_{w_{t,1}\geq 0}\geq 1$, yielding $\E[\sum_{T_0}^{T} w_{t,1}]\geq (3c/16)\sum_{T_0+2}^{T}1/t$.

nodes.name: Add early-rounds correction and conclude
nodes.statement: Bound $\E[\sum_{1}^{T_0-1} w_{t,1}]\geq -T_0$ via $w_{t,1}\geq -1$; combine to get $\E[\bar{w}_{T,1}]\geq \frac{3c}{16T}\sum_{T_0+2}^{T}\frac{1}{t}-\frac{T_0}{T}$, and note $F(\bar{\bw}_T)\geq \bar{w}_{T,1}$.

nodes.name: Per-step recurrence and suffix sum
nodes.statement: Reuse PP8.1's per-step inequality $\E[\norm{\bw_{t+1}-\bw^*}^2]\leq \E[\norm{\bw_t-\bw^*}^2]-2\eta_t\E[\inner{\bg_t,\bw_t-\bw^*}]+\eta_t^2 G^2$ and sum over $t=(1-\alpha)T+1,\ldots,T$.

nodes.name: Lower-bound LHS via convexity
nodes.statement: By convexity, $\sum_{t=(1-\alpha)T+1}^{T}\E[\inner{\bg_t,\bw_t-\bw^*}]\geq \sum_t \E[F(\bw_t)-F(\bw^*)]\geq \alpha T \E[F(\bar{\bw}^{\alpha}_T)-F(\bw^*)]$.

nodes.name: Plug Lemma close to bound $\E\norm{\bw_t-\bw^*}^2$
nodes.statement: Apply Lemma close (LP8.1) to bound each $\E\norm{\bw_t-\bw^*}^2\leq 4G^2/(\lambda^2 t)$, and substitute into the rearranged sum.

nodes.name: Use $\sum_{(1-\alpha)T+1}^{T}1/t\leq \log(1/(1-\alpha))$
nodes.statement: Bound the harmonic suffix sum by $\log(1/(1-\alpha))$ and simplify to obtain $\E[F(\bar{\bw}^{\alpha}_T)-F(\bw^*)]\leq \frac{2+2.5\log(1/(1-\alpha))}{\alpha}\frac{G^2}{\lambda T}$.

nodes.name: Identify martingale $Z_i=\inner{\hat{\bz}_i,\bw_i-\bw^*}$
nodes.statement: Define $Z_i=\inner{\hat{\bz}_i,\bw_i-\bw^*}$ with $\hat{\bz}_i=\bg_i-\hat{\bg}_i$; note $\E_{i-1}[Z_i]=0$ and $\var_{i-1}(Z_i)\leq 4G^2\norm{\bw_i-\bw^*}^2$.

nodes.name: Uniform step-bound from Lemma uniformupperbound
nodes.statement: Using Lemma uniformupperbound (LP8.5), $|(i-1)Z_i|\leq 2G(t-1)\norm{\bw_i-\bw^*}\leq 4G^2(t-1)/\lambda$.

nodes.name: Apply Freedman-style bound (Lemma fromFreedman)
nodes.statement: Apply Lemma fromFreedman (LP8.3) to $\sum_{i=2}^{t}(i-1)Z_i$ to obtain, with prob.\ $\geq 1-\delta$ for all $t\leq T$, an $8G\max\{\sqrt{\sum (i-1)^2\norm{\bw_i-\bw^*}^2},G(t-1)\sqrt{\log(\log T/\delta)}/\lambda\}\sqrt{\log(\log T/\delta)}$ tail bound.

nodes.name: Plug into recursive decomposition (Lemma recursive-def)
nodes.statement: Substitute the Freedman bound into Lemma recursive-def (LP8.6) to obtain $\norm{\bw_{t+1}-\bw^*}^2\leq \frac{b}{(t-1)t}\sqrt{\sum (i-1)^2\norm{\bw_i-\bw^*}^2}+\frac{c}{t}$ with $b,c$ defined in terms of $G,\lambda,\log\log T/\delta$.

nodes.name: Inductive step: solve quadratic for $a$
nodes.statement: Assume $\norm{\bw_i-\bw^*}^2\leq a/i$; deriving $a-(3b/2)\sqrt{a}-(3c/2)\geq 0$ and using $(x+y)^2\leq 2(x^2+y^2)$ shows $a\geq 9b^2/4+3c$ suffices.

nodes.name: Substitute $b,c$ to obtain $a=(624\log(\log T/\delta)+1)G^2/\lambda^2$
nodes.statement: Plugging $b=16G\sqrt{\log(\log T/\delta)}/\lambda$, $c=G^2(16\log(\log T/\delta)+1)/\lambda^2$ gives $a=(624\log(\log T/\delta)+1)G^2/\lambda^2$; the $\delta<1/e$ condition ensures the base case $a\geq 8G^2/\lambda^2$.
